about: Email marketing specialist and Shopify expert focused on turning owned channels into a reliable revenue line. I build and optimize Klaviyo flows, write conversion-first copy, and run disciplined A/B testing across subject lines, content, and send timing. Across freelance and agency work I've supported brands in the US, EU, and the Philippines — pairing sharp segmentation with clean, responsive template design to lift open rates, click-through, and customer lifetime value.
